messages:
deploybot: :warning: AUTOMATED HOLD - incident INC-4523 triggered a release hold for canary lane in eu-west-1. Reason: redis broker flapping. All pending canary/deploy slots paused and previous stable version v1.42.3 pinned automatically. See https://incidents.redwood/INC-4523
emma: ack. I'm pulling the canary nodes out of rotation now.
liam: what roll/backup path are we using if the flapping continues? do we roll the canary back to v1.42.2 or keep v1.42.3 pinned?
sara: ops running smoke tests against control plane and routing. ETA ~12m. will report results.
deploybot: suggested commands:
```
# pause canary and pin
deploybot pause --scope=canary --reason "INC-4523 redis flapping" --pin v1.42.3
# suspend backfill queues
deploybot queue suspend --name=release-backfill
```
emma: ran the pause + pin command, confirmed pinned to v1.42.3 :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Incident INC-4523 updated: redis brokers flapping in eu-west-1; mitigation: bumped replica count + restarted broker-3; monitoring on.
sara: smoke results: control plane ok, but there are intermittent 503s on long-tail requests (~0.1%); still investigating upstream redis timeouts.
liam: ok plan proposal:
- hold for 30m while ops validates (watching 504/503 trends)
- if error rate drops <0.05% -> resume canary, gradual ramp, rollforward
- if error rate stays high or increases -> rollback canary traffic and reschedule release window to tonight 02:00 UTC (hotpatch window)
emma: agree. I'll notify release coordinator and update the release ticket. @product heads should know the release is delayed.
sara: tagging @oncall for followups and telemetry checks. also adding checklist items to thread: update release notes, update Jira, send short note to #release-ops if we push.
liam: small kube snippet to divert traffic if needed:
```
kubectl patch svc inference-canary -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"canary":"false"}}}'
```
emma: adding note to PR and release notes draft: "Postponed due to infrastructure incident (INC-4523)"
deploybot: hold scheduled to auto-expire in 30m (1799994022) unless extended. Manual options: `deploybot resume --thread=1799992222` or `deploybot extend --minutes=30`
sara: will update approx timeline in 15m after next smoke. if we decide rollback i'll post rollback plan here (short commands + owner).
liam: +1. Thanks team. keeping this thread for final decision. :lock:
